career_ladder.note: Technicians (T-1) in ICAR institutes are recruited centrally by ICAR-IARI to support laboratory analytical services, field trial management, germplasm nurseries, agricultural farm machinery, and post-harvest technology units across 64+ ICAR research institutes. Governed by the ICAR Technical Service Rules (TSR), progression is based on a structured five-year assessment promotion system that is independent of vacancy availability.

exam_scheme.note: The recruitment examination for ICAR-IARI Technician (T-1) is conducted as an all-India Computer Based Test (CBT) of 100 objective multiple choice questions of 10th standard (Matriculation) difficulty, followed by Document Verification.

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated based on 7th CPC Level 3 entry basic pay of ₹21,700. Dearness Allowance at canonical 58% equals ₹12,586. House Rent Allowance ranges from ₹2,170 (10% in Z-class rural agricultural stations) to ₹6,510 (30% in X-class cities like IARI Pusa, New Delhi). Transport Allowance ranges from ₹1,422 to ₹2,133 (including 58% DA). Monthly deductions include National Pension System (10% of Basic + DA = ₹3,429), employee health scheme, and welfare fund.
official_perks: Allotted Type-II / Type-III ICAR institutional residential quarters across ICAR research campuses or HRA
Transport Allowance and overtime allowance for seasonal harvesting/laboratory shift duties
Comprehensive medical facilities under ICAR Medical Attendance Rules or CGHS in recognized hospitals
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and annual earned/casual leave benefits
Defined contribution benefits under National Pension System (NPS) with 14% government contribution and Central Government Gratuity
Children Education Allowance (CEA) per central government rules
